name: 164. Gemini keeps schemaless function tools and orders tool results by call id (#7926 / PR #7927) (gemini-tools-and-tool-results)
description: Issue #7926, two request-translation bugs on the Anthropic Messages / Responses -> Gemini path (core/providers/gemini/responses.go). (1) A function tool declared without input_schema converts to a ResponsesTool with a nil ResponsesToolFunction, and convertResponsesToolsToGemini skipped it, so the request reached Gemini with no tools. It is now declared by name and description. (2) Vertex blanks functionCall.id and functionResponse.id (stripVertexGeminiUnsupportedFields) and pairs results with calls by position, but the converter forwarded function responses in client order, so tool_result blocks returned out of tool_use order were attached to the wrong calls. Each batch of function responses is now reordered to follow the preceding calls (orderFunctionResponsesByCallID). Neither bug errors, so every case asserts the outbound payload via x-bf-send-back-raw-request: the schemaless tool appears in tools[].functionDeclarations (gemini and vertex), and the reversed tool_result pair reaches the wire in call order (vertex, where pairing is positional, and gemini, which shares the converter). Fixture is the issue repro: do not put the tool_result blocks back in call order, or the ordering cases pass vacuously. The folder name deliberately omits the word vertex so the gemini rows stay in the gemini partition. Run with PROVIDER=gemini and PROVIDER=vertex, FEATURE="gemini-tools-and-tool-results".

exec: // #7926: an Anthropic tool with no input_schema converts to a function tool with a nil
// ResponsesToolFunction, and convertResponsesToolsToGemini only declared tools that had one, so the
// request reached Gemini with no tools and the model answered as if it had none. Nothing errors, so
// raw_request is the pin. Red pre-fix: no functionDeclaration named get_time in raw_request.tools.
